name: orthogonal
description: Connect agents to paid APIs and live data from verified providers through Orthogonal's hosted MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Live data and APIs for agents
interface.longDescription: Orthogonal gives ChatGPT and Codex one connection to APIs and live data from verified providers: people and company enrichment, web search and scraping, and more, without separate provider accounts or keys. Describe a task and Orthogonal finds matching endpoints and shows what each one needs before anything runs. You approve each call that runs an endpoint, and your account's activity stays visible at any time. For developers, Orthogonal also returns code to call the same endpoint from your own app. Requires an Orthogonal account. Results come from third-party providers and can vary by provider.
defaultPrompt: Find an API that gets a person's work email and show its price.
Scrape https://example.com with Orthogonal and summarize it.
What's my Orthogonal credit balance and recent usage?

positive.description: Find a paid API and its price without running it
positive.prompt: Find an API on Orthogonal that returns a person's work email from their name and company, and tell me what it costs.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching endpoints with their prices and parameters. Nothing runs and nothing is charged.

positive.description: Price one exact request without running it
positive.prompt: How much would it cost to scrape https://example.com with Orthogonal?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the price in USD for that request. Nothing runs and nothing is charged.

positive.description: Run one paid call after the user approves it
positive.prompt: Use Orthogonal to scrape https://example.com and summarize the page.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks the user to approve the paid call, then summarizes the page. A few cents of credits are charged to the test account.

positive.description: Read the signed-in account's balance and usage
positive.prompt: What's my Orthogonal credit balance and what did I spend recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the test account's credit balance and its recent calls with their cost. Nothing is charged.

positive.description: Generate code to call an endpoint from the user's own app
positive.prompt: Give me TypeScript code to call an Orthogonal web search endpoint from my app.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a TypeScript code sample for a web search endpoint. Nothing runs and nothing is charged.

negative.description: Moving money or crypto is out of scope
negative.prompt: Send 0.1 ETH from my wallet to this address: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing in ChatGPT; paid calls spend credits the user already holds in their Orthogonal account.

publication.release_notes: First release: search, price and run Orthogonal APIs from ChatGPT and Codex.
